root.label: Michigan AG releases Flint water crisis report

events.label: Michigan AG releases Flint water crisis report

slots.name: report length
slots.sentence: Most of the 101-page report provides a history of the crisis, local and state officials' slow response and the attempt to bring 42 felony and misdemeanor charges against nine people, including former Republican Gov. Rick Snyder.

slots.name: criminal charges
slots.sentence: the attempt to bring 42 felony and misdemeanor charges against nine people, including former Republican Gov. Rick Snyder.

slots.name: Flint funding
slots.sentence: About $170 million went to Flint to address lead in the drinking water.

slots.name: settlement amount
slots.sentence: In 2020, a judge approved a $626 million settlement for Flint residents and others who were exposed to lead-contaminated water.

slots.name: appointed justices
slots.sentence: She also questioned the political implications of the ruling, noting three of the justices who joined the unanimous ruling were appointed by Snyder.
